metadata.title: Disco Era Portrait with High-Contrast Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up dual portrait of two women with voluminous hair, featuring a soft-focus, warm-toned photographic style characteristic of late 1970s glamour, overlaid with large, vibrant red serif lettering across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting with vibrant primary red text
Soft-focus photographic texture against sharp typographic edges
Symmetrical placement of subjects beneath a centered headline
Metallic props (whistles) providing small specular highlights
coreInvariants: High-saturation red for the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two female subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tight, medium-close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red text at the top serves as the primary anchor, followed by the subjects' eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red text, moves down to the subjects' eyes, and then to the metallic objects held in their mouths.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subjects' hair and faces, creating an intimate, crowded feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers in the skin and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant primary red for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text; muted, naturalistic saturation in the photography with deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, sepia-adjacent photographic base

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tracking to span the width of the frame

composition.overlap: Slightly overlapping the hair of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; secondary metadata in small sans-serif at the bottom corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look of the era.
Provides the high-fashion, high-contrast stroke weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, grainy 1970s style photograph of two women with large afro-textured hair, warm lighting, and metallic whistles in their mouths, looking directly at the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a single word in all-caps using a bold, high-contrast serif font in bright red, positioned at the top with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the photographic style grainy and warm?
Are the serifs sharp and distinct?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the frame?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is the most saturated element.
Check that the grain looks like film stock, not digital noise.
Verify the serif font has high stroke contrast.
Confirm the subjects are positioned symmetrically.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned, soft-focus dual portrait with a bold, wide-tracked red serif headline at the top margin.
